Owd Bob
programme.desc: The story of a young orphaned boy who is sent to live with his grandfather in Ireland. The boy finds adjusting to the country life challenging, but soon learns the life has its rewards as well.

programme.title: Lost on a Mountain in Maine
El camino
programme.desc: Elliot, 31, a product of the Washington D.C. foster care system, has spent most of his life moving from place to place. When he is contacted by Matthew, a childhood friend from "the system" dying of cancer, Elliot goes to be by his side. At the funeral, he meets Gray and Lily, two friends of Matthew, both aimless in their present lives. Motivated by their sense of loss, and personal anger, Gray, Lily and Elliot steal Matthew's ashes and take them to Mexico. As the three travelers journey cross-country with Matthew's urn in tow, they are forced to confront their own sense of family, identity and future. Set against the changing American landscape, EL CAMINO follows these characters as they search for themselves in a country that has lost it's own identity. Gray, the wayward son of a prominent D.C. family, has left his pregnant girlfriend. He is angry, volatile and fearful of commitment. Lily is Matthew's ex-girlfriend. Unbeknownst to her parents, she has dropped out of college and become an exotic dancer. Lost in alcohol and pills she longs for her mother's approval. Elliot is outside the cultural mainstream. He carries a suitcase filled with documents and mementos of his life. An explorer of human experience, he interviews and videotapes people he meets. Haunted by dreams of his mother's drowning, Elliot struggles to find his place in the world. EL CAMINO is a humorous and compassionate film about friendship, family, and search for self in today's American landscape

programme.title: Running for Grace
programme.desc: A timeless story set in Hawaii in 1920s, about a young man who transcends the boundaries of race and class in search of forbidden love.

programme.title: Imaginary Heroes
programme.desc: A shocking and tragic event causes the members of a quietly dysfunctional family to reexamine themselves and their lives in this drama. Ben and Sandy Travis (Jeff Daniels and Sigourney Weaver) are a couple whose troubled family begins to crumble when their eldest son, star college athlete Matt (Kip Pardue) commits suicide. Sandy's naturally cynical nature becomes all the more prickly, and while she tries to bond with her surviving teenaged son, Tim (Emile Hirsch), they seem closest when they discover a shared fondness for marijuana. Ben also tries to reach out to Tim, but the young man is never able to shake the feeling that he's never quite been the son his father wanted. Tim has a girlfriend, Steph (Suzanne Santo), but their relationship has been going through a rocky patch, and Tim finds himself questioning his feelings about women and men when his friendship with next-door neighbor Kyle (Ryan Donowho) evolves into something more intimate.

programme.title: Pontipul
programme.desc: When disc jockey Grant Mazzy reports to his basement radio station in the Canadian town of Pontypool, he thinks it's just another day at work. But when he hears reports of a virus that turns people into zombies, Mazzy barricades himself in the radio booth and tries to figure out a way to warn his listeners about the virus and its unlikely mode of transmission.

programme.title: Rain
programme.desc: A German Shepard named Rain is trained to fight in the Vietnam War and his intelligence and courage in the face of adversity wins the respect and loyalty of his platoon.

programme.title: Wild Fire
programme.desc: Dream Town Development real estate bosses Jack Del Rio and Sy Richards can't convince animal lover Carol Tanner to sell and relocate safari/animal retirement ranch Wild Land, which she runs with younger sister Ballad since their parents died in a plane crash. Jack hires Bradshaw and Roach to release tiger Caesar, after that fails to cause a scandal to start a forest fire and release all animals, after tying up Carol. Ballad's lover, committed Glendora, southern California fire captain Kennedy, and his jumper team try their best to control the fire. Meanwhile young sheriff Drake Donovan and Ballad drug and catch wild animals. The arson is discovered, but the fiends aren't done yet.

programme.title: The Year Dolly Parton Was My Mom
programme.desc: Elizabeth Alison Gray is just your average suburban 11-year old waiting for adolescence to arrive when she finds out her whole life has been a lie. With only her imagination to guide her, she runs away to find the truth.

programme.title: Almost Friends
programme.desc: Charlie, a culinary genius, has lost the motivation. He doesn't know what to with his life anymore, but he knows one thing _ get close to Amber. In comparison to her boyfriend, he seems to be totally unattractive, but Charlie's closest friend convinces him that where there's a will there's a way.

programme.title: Land Of the Blind
programme.desc: A soldier recounts his relationship with a famous political prisoner attempting to overthrow their country's authoritarian government.

programme.title: Digging Into China
programme.desc: Harriet, a ten-year old girl, lives together with her big sister and her alcoholic mother out in the countryside. The family runs a motel. Harriet is different from the others, as she owns a great creativity and has nobody to play with. Her infinite world exists only in her mind. One day, Ricky comes along. He is a grown-up, but retarded son of an elderly lady. Soon, Harriet and Ricky share their experiences of life from a different point of view and become close friends. But his mother still plans to give Ricky away into professional care in a home, because she won't live forever to be there for him.

programme.title: Unexpected
programme.desc: Bob and Amy are at a crossroads: she wants to adopt a child, he doesn't. Will renovating their house and rescuing animals solve their problems? Will their new handyman and his son's pregnant girlfriend be the miracle they're looking for?...

programme.title: Savršena žena
programme.desc: Lia je svom bratu Rubenu bila kao majka, sve dok ga jednog dana nije pokosio i ubio pijani bajker. Od tog trenutka, na umu ima samo osvetu, a platiće svi: od vozača motora, koji je u komi, do lekara koji nije uspeo da spase život njenom bratu.

programme.title: Banda iz Osa
programme.desc: Johana želi da promeni svoj život i napusti kriminalne bande u gradu Osu tokom 30-ih godina 20. veka, ali što se više trudi, sve se više upliće.

programme.title: Predaja
programme.desc: Ova beskompromisna akciona drama, prepuna autentičnih MMA borbi, donosi snažnu i nadahnjujuću priču o iskupljenju.

programme.title: Noćna tabla
programme.desc: Uživajte uz "Noćnu tablu" _ dinamičan informativno-zabavni magazin.

programme.title: Mrvica i rudnik zlata
programme.desc: Nakon ponovnog ujedinjenja s porodicom, Mrvica se teško navikava na luksuzan život. Kada ga otme stari neprijatelj, mora upotrebiti najbolje stečeno znanje iz novog i starog života, kako bi pobegao i spasao svoje roditelje.

programme.title: Vellčanstveni Ambersonovi
programme.desc: Razmaženo derište, Džordž Amberson, užasnut je kada njegova majka, odnedavno udovica, obnovi vezu s imućnim Judžinom Morganom, koga je ostavila nekoliko decenija ranije, kako bi se udala za Džordžovog oca. Dok se Džordž trudi da sabotira romansu svoje majke, mora se nositi i sa sopstvenim osećanjima prema Morganovoj ćerci.

programme.title: Smrtonosni medeni mesec
programme.desc: Par se venčava na Havajima i za medeni mesec polaze na krstarenje, ali stvari kreću užasno loše

programme.title: Žena, pištolj i prodavnica rezanaca
programme.desc: Vang je depresivni, prepredeni, pohlepni vlasnik prodavnice nudli u pustinjskom kineskom gradu. Njegova zapuštena supruga oštrog jezika u tajnoj je vezi sa Lijem, jednim od Vangovih radnika. Plašljivi Li nevoljno uzima pištolj koji mu je ljubavnica kupila da ubije njenog muža. Ali Vang posmatra svaki njihov korak i plaća policajcu Žangu da ih oboje ubije. To deluje kao savršen plan: afera će imati okrutan, krvav i pravičan kraj. Tačnije, to on misli, jer poremećeni Žang ima sopstveni plan. Uslediće još veća erupcija krvi, prevara i nasilja.

programme.title: Gorko-slatko
programme.desc: Ekscentrični i bogati trgovac kafom, šalje priznatog stručnjaka u Tajland, gde treba da otkupi novu, egzotičnu vrstu kafe. Njegov "savršen" život ispada iz koloseka kad se, nakon prvobitne netrpeljivosti, zaljubljuje u prelepu ćerku vlasnika plantaže, a onda otkriva da ga šef ustvari uopšte nije poslao zbog kupovine kafe.

programme.title: Čovek od poverenja
programme.desc: Priča o Beriju Monkovu, mladom harizmatičnom biznismenu koji postaje imućni direktor i stiže do samog vrha uz pomoć laži, prevara i krađe.

programme.title: Loša genetika
programme.desc: Žena koja je ostavljena jedanaest puta, otkriva (na svoje zaprepašćenje) da ima gubitničke ljubavne gene.

programme.title: Pravo mesto i vreme za pisanje
programme.desc: Pejdžina majka želi da ćerka krene njenim stopama i preuzme vođenje velikog konglomerata, ali Pejdž želi da bude spisateljica. Kada Džoan odluči da proda izdavačku kuću Atlas zbog manjka klijenata i prihoda, Pejdž to vidi kao priliku da joj pruži poslednju šansu _ ovaj put pišući pod pseudonimom, tako da niko, pa ni Danijel, poslednja nada izdavača, ne zna da upravo njena porodica predstavlja pretnju.

programme.title: Uhvati me za ruku
programme.desc: Majka troje dece, koja živi u Londonu i nalazi se na vrhuncu karijere, saznaje da boluje od multiple skleroze. Nakon iznenadne smrti supruga i gubitka posla, vraća se u rodnu Australiju, gde slučajan susret sa srednjoškolskom ljubavi budi novu nadu u ljubav dok vodi tešku borbu sa bolešću.

programme.title: Smrtonosni obračun
programme.desc: Supruga policajca ubijena je kada se njegova porodica zatekla usred pljačke prodavnice. Zbog načina na koji je postupio prema pljačkašima, zbog čega je i došlo do pucnjave, deca ga sada krive za smrt svoje majke.

programme.title: Pravda za sve
programme.desc: Kada Sietl opsednu nasilni i bezobzirni dileri heroinom, Elija Kejn pokreće elitnu policijsku jedinici da ih privedu pravdi. Kejn i njegov tim zanemaruju pravila službe i služe se svim i brutalnim metodama u nameri da sa gradskih ulica sklone trgovce droge.

programme.title: Pravda za sve
programme.desc: Ilajža Kejn, bivši operativac specijalne jedinice i ekspert za borilačke veštine, deo je policijskog tima za tajne zadatke koji često na brutalan način sprovodi zakon na ulici.

programme.title: Pravda za sve
programme.desc: Ilajža Kejn, bivši operativac specijalne jedinice i ekspert za borilačke veštine, deo je policijskog tima za tajne zadatke koji često na brutalan način sprovodi zakon na ulici.

programme.title: Utvrđivanje smrti
programme.desc: Kako bi pobegao od ogromnih kockarskih dugova, veoma odbojni Ris Vilijams odlučuje da inscenira sopstvenu smrt, uz pomoć dugogodišnje sapatnice, supruge Kejti. Kad Ris "umre", Kejti nasleđuje pet miliona dolara od polise osiguranja, što će im pomoći da otplate dugove i započnu novi život na nekom drugom mestu. Ali, da li je moguće da prevara krene po zlu, a Ris završi zaista mrtav? Risova svastika, Džini, mogla bi obezbediti validne informacije agentima osiguranja, Loganu i Meku, od kojih je jedan zaljubljen u Kejti.

programme.title: Pad Kandahara
programme.desc: 1999 godina, britanski miner koji radi za Talibane u Avganistanu, mora da beži, kad je uvučen u smrtonosnu igru, zaveru i izdaju.

programme.title: Noćna tabla
programme.desc: Uživajte uz "Noćnu tablu" _ dinamičan informativno-zabavni magazin.

programme.title: Istina o lažima
programme.desc: Gilbi se zatiče u zamršenoj mreži laži, jer je istinu preteško priznati, a još teže prihvatiti.

programme.title: Raskinuli smo
programme.desc: Dugogodišnji partneri Lori i Dag raskidaju samo nekoliko dana pre venčanja Lorine mlađe sestre Bi i Džejsona. Da ne bi pokvarili slavlje, odlučuju da se pretvaraju da su i dalje zajedno dok vikend ne prođe.

programme.title: Julije Cezar
programme.desc: Epohalan prikaz Julija Cezara, posljednjeg diktatora Rima, čija smrt je također označila kraj Rimske Republike. Priča o njegovim kampanjama u Galiji i Egiptu, njegovoj rivalstvu s generalom Pompejem i konačnom atentatu pod rukama Bruta i Kasija.

programme.title: Julije Cezar
programme.desc: Epohalan prikaz Julija Cezara, posljednjeg diktatora Rima, čija smrt je također označila kraj Rimske Republike. Priča o njegovim kampanjama u Galiji i Egiptu, njegovoj rivalstvu s generalom Pompejem i konačnom atentatu pod rukama Bruta i Kasija.

programme.title: Deset stvari koje bi trebalo da uradimo pre raskida
programme.desc: Kada Ebigejl, samohrana majka dvoje dece, zatrudni nakon jedne noći provedene s Benom, ovaj neobični par pokušaće da se izbori s novonastalom situacijom.

programme.title: Ukradena dolina
programme.desc: Da bi spasila život svojoj majci, meksičko-navaho mehaničarka udružuje snage s odmetnicom kako bi se suprotstavile korumpiranom zemljoposedniku.

programme.title: Ljubavni brodolom
programme.desc: Na krstarenju Karibima, Dženi ostaje nasukana na jednoj obali sa svojim rokenrol idolom. Očarana idejom da će neko vreme provesti nasamo s njim, uspeva da sakrije činjenicu da se nalaze na samo nekoliko koraka od svog odmarališta.

programme.title: Ljubav i Meri
programme.desc: Meri je profinjena poslastičarka. Trudi se održati svoju pekaru, ali jednog dana je izbacivanje iz poslovnog prostora prisiljava na zatvaranje posla. Meri sa svojim zaručnikom Brentom odlučuje otputovati ka svojoj porodici u Teksas, od koje treba da dobije verenički poklon. Na njenu nesreću Brent dobija napad alergije koja ga sprečava da ide na put. Meri odlučuje sa sobom povesti Brentovog identičnog brata blizanca koji je upravo izašao iz zatvora i predstaviti ga porodici kao svog verenika. Da li će to da bude dobra ideja?

programme.title: Ljubav na prvi klik
programme.desc: Cinična novinarka dobija zadatak da piše o zavodniku sa dejting aplikacija, ali ubrzo otkriva da se iza njegove reputacije krije mnogo više od onoga što je očekivala.

programme.title: Uzmi novac i beži
programme.desc: OneCoin odavno nije samo kriptovaluta, već pokret čiji je neprikosnoveni vođa Ruja Ignatova. Uverena u sopstvenu nepogrešivost, pokušava da zaključi ambiciozan posao sa uticajnim biznismenom Li Čanom u Hongkongu. Međutim, upravo će taj potez pokrenuti događaje koji će ugroziti sve što je izgradila.

programme.title: Izgubljeno vreme
programme.desc: "Sećanje" je fantastična ljubavna priča koja se odvija usred užasa nemačkog koncentracionog logora u Poljskoj, 1944. godine. Ovu nemoguću strast potpaljuje hrabrost poljskog zatvorenika, koji uspeva da spase svoju devojku, Jevrejku. Neočekivano, beže iz logora i preživljavaju opasan put u slobodu. Ali tokom haosa na kraju rata se razdvajaju i jedno za drugo misle da nisu preživeli. Više od trideset godina kasnije u Njujorku, srećno udata 52-godišnja žena, slučajno otkriva da je njen voljeni Poljak još uvek živ i želi da ga vidi.

programme.title: Crni lotos
programme.desc: Bivši specijalac vodi lični rat na ulicama Amsterdama kako bi spasao ćerku svog prijatelja iz kandži lokalnog kriminalnog sindikata.

programme.title: Obožavam te!
programme.desc: Grej Evans i Mia Lang su mladi glumački par čiji brak je dinamičan čak i nakon godinu dana. Glamurozne premijere i opijanja na VIP žurkama, gde mogu da se druže s Elvisom Kostelom, čitanje pošte obožavalaca i sve ono što im garantuje simpatije i naklonost publike. Ali prava slika Grejove narcisoidnosti jeste njegovo verovanje da ga neko uhodi. To možda jeste, možda i nije istina, ali njegova fiksacija je tolika da ne samo da zamišlja sopstvenu smrt, već počinje i sam da uhodi radnika video kluba, koga smatra srećnijim od sebe. Grej ujedno fantazira o običnom životu s bivšom devojkom.

programme.title: Igra u četvoro
programme.desc: Kerol (Alis Taljoni), ilustratorka knjiga za decu, ugovara pregled kod ginekologa. Pokazuje se da je ginekolog poznanik Lajonel (Fransoa Kluzet). Kerol i Lajonel tokom tog pregleda slučajno otkrivaju da njihove partnere veže ljubavnički odnos. Oboje žele da spasu svoje veze. Zato se dogovaraju da će učiniti sve kako bi povratili svoje partnere. Kako bi ostvarili cilj koriste se različitim metodima i načinima, često smešnim. Uskoro nešto dublje počinje povezivati Kerol i Lajonela. Osveta je slatka.

programme.title: Dolina borbi
programme.desc: Mlada žena pronađena je mrtva nakon uplitanja u nezakonite borbe. Njena sestra, Vindzor, počinje da trenira s poznatim bivšim borcem, u nameri da tako pronađe ubicu.

programme.title: Noćna tabla
programme.desc: Uživajte uz "Noćnu tablu" _ dinamičan informativno-zabavni magazin.

programme.title: Olimpijski snovi
programme.desc: U Olimpijskom selu sportista mlada skijašica se zbližava sa volonterom dok se završava njen takmičarski nastup.

programme.title: Žena, pištolj i prodavnica rezanaca
programme.desc: Vang je depresivni, prepredeni, pohlepni vlasnik prodavnice nudli u pustinjskom kineskom gradu. Njegova zapuštena supruga oštrog jezika u tajnoj je vezi sa Lijem, jednim od Vangovih radnika. Plašljivi Li nevoljno uzima pištolj koji mu je ljubavnica kupila da ubije njenog muža. Ali Vang posmatra svaki njihov korak i plaća policajcu Žangu da ih oboje ubije. To deluje kao savršen plan: afera će imati okrutan, krvav i pravičan kraj. Tačnije, to on misli, jer poremećeni Žang ima sopstveni plan. Uslediće još veća erupcija krvi, prevara i nasilja.

programme.title: Vampirice
programme.desc: Dve vampirice u današnjem Njujorku suočavaju se sa zastrašujućim ljubavnim mogućnostima.

programme.title: Satin
programme.desc: Propali pevač iz Las Vegasa, Džek Satin, nema novca, nema posao i u zabludi je da će se proslaviti. Kada je primoran da napusti Vegas, seda u svoj stari kadilak i odlazi u Atlantik Siti. Tamo upoznaje Loren, vlasnicu lokalnog bara koja mu pomaže da shvati da je život mnogo više od puke jurnjave za slavom i bogatstva.

programme.title: Kralj boraca
programme.desc: Film akcije na osnovi priče iz video igre "Kralj ratnika".

programme.title: Čekanje na sreću
programme.desc: Ko kaže da morate da pobedite da biste postali šampion? Slava Kolotilof, učitelj iz mirnog primorskog gradića Fingers, kreće u osvajanje Moskve, s originalnim rukopisom svog prvog romana. Umesto toga, sasvim nenadano, osvaja srce lepotice Nađe, koju glumi Mila Jovović. Venčanje se bliži i Slava mora da napusti posao i pozdravi se sa Fingersom, pre povratka u Moskvu i početka novog života sa svojom nevestom. Ali, zbog spleta bizarnih okolnosti, ne može da se vrati u veliki grad. Venčanje će se održati bez obzira na sve, a Nađa mora da se odbrani od napada bivšeg dečka Danje, koji je na sve spreman kako bi je vratio.

programme.title: Tinejdžerka tajni agent
programme.desc: Žestoki, snalažljivi privatni detektiv, pristaje da u okviru istrage FBI bude deo tajnog zadatka unutar bratstva na koledžu.

programme.title: Disko
programme.desc: Didje je četrdesetogodišnjak _ fan disko muzike. Muškarac nema posla i još uvek živi sa majkom. Didje ima sina, kojeg dugo nije video, ipak njegova majka ne slaže se da zajedno provedu odmor. Didje odlučuje da pobedi u plesnom konkursu, da dobije nagradu i da povede sina na nezaboravni odmor u Australiju. Muškarac nagovara svoje prijatelje da mu pomognu. Zapošljavaju trenera, koji treba da ih pripremi za takmičenje. Brzo se uspostavlja, da makar nekad bili su odlični plesači, vreme je uradilo svoje. Moraju puno da rade da bi nastupili.

programme.title: Kamp snova
programme.desc: Devojka koja nema mnogo dodirnih tačaka sa sportom, Vitni Karmajkl, prijavljuje se u fizički veoma zahtevan letnji kamp kako bi unela promene u svoj život, ali se tamo zaljubljuje u svog trenera. Na svom putovanju pronalazi snagu da prihvati sebe onakvu kakva jeste i da se oslobodi tuđih očekivanja.

programme.title: Ubojita magija
programme.desc: Na turneji po Britaniji 1926. godine, Hari Hudini započinje strastvenu vezu sa vidovnjakinjom koja namerava da prevari sjajnog mađioničara.

programme.title: Biografija zločinca
programme.desc: So Do-jong naređuje Dong-suu da osnuje novu advokatsku kancelariju nakon propasti prethodne.

programme.title: Biografija zločinca
programme.desc: Nakon promena u rukovodstvu, Do-jong preuzima vlast, a posledice ranijih postupaka menjaju živote svih umešanih.

programme.title: Ona je kriminalac
programme.desc: Sju Parker gurnuta je u očajničku borbu da spase porodični posao koji se, zbog nemara njenog oca, nalazi na ivici propasti. Dolaskom šarmantnog skitnice, ona prepoznaje jedinu nadu da spreči da njihov bar padne u ruke nemilosrdnog lokalnog tajkuna.

programme.title: Barska svađa!
programme.desc: Nina i Alen nakon raskida dele sve što su zajedno stekli u životu, ali ih očekuje urnebesna borba za vlasništvo nad njihovim dragocenim pabom. U ovoj borbi povlači se crta, bira se strana i počinje ludo takmičenje u ispijanju piva.

programme.title: Smash-up, the Story of a Woman
programme.desc: A successful nightclub singer weds a struggling songwriter, but when his fame eclipses hers, she delves into alcoholism.

programme.title: Anna Christie
programme.desc: A troubled young woman comes to live with her estranged father on the New York waterfront. A tough sailor falls in love with her, sparking conflict between her father and her suitor. What neither knows is that she has a secret that could cause her to lose both of them.

programme.title: Omsch
programme.desc: A travelling artist, painter and filmmaker has a centenarian neighbour. The relationship between this man in his forties and the solitary old lady with a wicked sense of humour gradually becomes a kind of elective kinship. Their discussions, interrupted and picked up again over the years, form the fabric of this personal, tender and surprising film.

programme.title: The Frontiersmen
programme.desc: The local school is causing Hoppy problems. First Bar 20 cattle are stolen when Hoppy investigates a problem there. Then the new teacher arrives and disrupts the routine of the Bar 20 hands. Later with the Bar 20 hands at graduation, the rustlers are poised to strike again. But there is dissension among them and this will lead to the break that Hoppy needs.

programme.title: Our Daily Bread
programme.desc: John and Mary Sims are city-dwellers hit hard by the financial fist of The Depression. Driven by bravery (and sheer desperation) they flee to the country and, with the help of other workers, set up a farming community _ a socialist mini-society. The newborn community suffers many hardships _ drought, vicious raccoons and the long arm of the law _ but ultimately pull together to reach a bread-based Utopia.

programme.title: They Made Me a Criminal
programme.desc: A champion boxer on the lamb, believed to have committed murder while drunk, takes refuge and finds redemption at a farm for delinquent youths.

programme.title: Psycho-Circus
programme.desc: A circus becomes the location for stolen loot and murder.

programme.title: Judge Priest
programme.desc: Judge Priest, a proud Confederate veteran, restores the justice in a small town in the Post-Bellum Kentucky using his common sense and his great sense of humanity.

programme.title: Arima
programme.desc: ARIMA It is the story of four women and a girl who- se existence is disrupted by the sudden arrival of two strangers. One of them is fleeing from the other, sneaking around town like an elusive being, a ghostly presence of uncertain existence. The other character --an injured man carrying a gun-- will disrupt the women's way of life in different ways. The whole plot takes place on the fine line between reality and imagination, between dreams and nightmares, fear and desire, within a story shrouded in mystery ARIMA is something you glimpse through the mist, something you can sense but still fail to see clearly. A dream, a memory, a desire.

programme.title: New Voices in an Old Flower
programme.desc: "It was an era, it was the start of a new vision" says Amha Eshete, the first Ethiopian music producer back in the Golden Age, the days of Swingin' Addis. The album releases that have crossed Ethiopian borders are mainly recordings from the 50's to the 80's, however, the contemporary music scene from Addis remains, bar a few exceptions, unknown to the rest of the world. Is Addis still swinging as it used to? Music in Addis is present in actions and sounds spread out on differentiated spaces, it is an expression of the everyday urban life and its processes of transformation and adaptation in the city. New Voices In An Old Flower explores this vitality of music looking at the plurality of the city and its people. Drifting in unplanned tours through the urban landscape of contemporary Addis Ababa, this film is shaped by encounters, dialogues and collaborations with musicians and other inhabitants of the city.

programme.title: Santa Fe Marshall
programme.desc: U.S. Marshal Hopalong Cassidy is called when a town becomes overrun with bad guys. Disguised as a member of a medicine show, Hoppy discovers that the ringleader is none other than sweet li'l ol' Ma Burton.

programme.title: The Light of Western Stars
programme.desc: Due to a bet drunk Gene almost forces Majesty to marry him, then escapes after brawling with sheriff Tom. Majesty buys a ranch, needs Gene's help and finds him in a drunken stupor in Mexico. He vows to stay sober and fights crooked Tom.

programme.title: Club Paradise
programme.desc: A naive young girl, looking to escape from a bad family situation, falls in love with a man who turns out to be a cad, and leads her down the road to ruin.

programme.title: Black Dragons
programme.desc: A cabal of American industrialists, all fifth-columnists intent on sabotaging the war effort, are methodically murdered by the malevolent Monsieur Colomb.

programme.title: Tokyo Twilight
programme.desc: Two sisters find out the existence of their long-lost mother, but the younger cannot take the truth of being abandoned as a child.

programme.title: The Inspector General
programme.desc: An illiterate stooge in a traveling medicine show wanders into a strange town and is picked up on a vagrancy charge. The town's corrupt officials mistake him for the inspector general whom they think is traveling in disguise. Fearing he will discover they've been pocketing tax money, they make several bungled attempts to kill him.

programme.title: West of the Divide
programme.desc: Ted Hayden impersonates a wanted man and joins Gentry's gang only to learn later that Gentry was the one who killed his father. He saves Virginia Winters' dad's ranch from Gentry and also rescues his long-lost brother Spud.

programme.title: Till the Clouds Roll By
programme.desc: Songwriter and Broadway pioneer Jerome Kern is unable to find immediate success in the U.S. He sought recognition abroad. He journeyed to England where his dreams of success became real and where he met his future wife Eva Leale.

programme.title: McLintock!
programme.desc: Ageing, wealthy, rancher and self-made man, George Washington McLintock is forced to deal with numerous personal and professional problems. Seemingly everyone wants a piece of his enormous farmstead, including high-ranking government men and nearby Native Americans. As McLintock tries to juggle his various adversaries, his wife—who left him two years previously—suddenly returns. But she isn't interested in George; she wants custody of their daughter.

programme.title: A Midsummer Night's Dance
programme.desc: This is a wonderful story of a matchmaking event in Italy. Young men and women are escorted to a midsummer dance. There is a man who coordinates the proper arrangements and the mountain villages send their youth.

programme.title: The Outlaw
programme.desc: Newly appointed sheriff Pat Garrett is pleased when his old friend Doc Holliday arrives in Lincoln, New Mexico on the stage. Doc is trailing his stolen horse, and it is discovered in the possession of Billy the Kid. In a surprising turnaround, Billy and Doc become friends. This causes the friendship between Doc and Pat to cool. The odd relationship between Doc and Billy grows stranger when Doc hides Billy at his girl Rio's place after Billy is shot.

programme.title: Moulin Rouge
programme.desc: Parysia is the rage of Paris. She has a daughter, secretly engaged to Andre, and the boy's aristocratic father objects to the alliance because of Margaret's mother being a revue artist. Director Ewald Andre Dupont took almost a year to make Moulin Rouge at a production cost of $500,000, a huge amount for 1928.

programme.title: A Woman's Life
programme.desc: A woman remember's her own marriage when dealing with the love life of her son.

programme.title: Too Late for Tears
programme.desc: Through a fluke circumstance, a ruthless woman stumbles across a suitcase filled with $60,000, and is determined to hold onto it even if it means murder.

programme.title: 31 Hours
programme.desc: Stefan is an overworked surgeon who's just worked a thirty-one-hour shift. A last minute patient comes in and, as he is the only surgeon available, he goes in for one last operation before going home. Things do not go as planned though, and he loses the patient on the operating table. Starts a saga of deontological issues, where the corrupted Romanian health system comes under close scrutiny.

programme.title: The Trial
programme.desc: Josef K wakes up in the morning and finds the police in his room. They tell him that he is on trial but nobody tells him what he is accused of. In order to find out about the reason for this accusation and to protest his innocence, he tries to look behind the façade of the judicial system. But since this remains fruitless, there seems to be no chance for him to escape from this nightmare.

programme.title: Charade
programme.desc: Romance and suspense ensue in Paris as a woman is pursued by several men who want a fortune her murdered husband had stolen. Who can she trust?

programme.title: Smash-up, the Story of a Woman
programme.desc: A successful nightclub singer weds a struggling songwriter, but when his fame eclipses hers, she delves into alcoholism.

programme.title: The Red House
programme.desc: Old man conceals dark secret from adopted teen daughter.

programme.title: Beneath the 12-Mile Reef
programme.desc: Fierce competition among sponge fishermen forces a Greek-American family to fish in the dangerous 12-mile reef area off the western coast of Florida.

programme.title: Indiscreet
programme.desc: A young woman jeopardizes the relationship with the man she loves when a no-account from her past shows up.

programme.title: Mourning After
programme.desc: Afraid of losing herself, a woman meets with an old friend to discuss a difficult decision.

programme.title: The Last Time I Saw Paris
programme.desc: Love, marriage and heartache in paris after the war.

programme.title: The Last Time I Saw Paris
programme.desc: Love, marriage and heartache in paris after the war.

programme.title: The Strange Love of Martha Ivers
programme.desc: Ruthless woman has her dark past of a concealed murder return.

programme.title: Guerrero
programme.desc: In the depths of the Sierra of Guerrero in Mexico, after the disappearance of the 43 students, we find the reaction of wounded civil society to seek an answer to the situation of abuse of authority mixed with poverty.

programme.title: Cyrano de Bergerac
programme.desc: Swordsman-poet helps soldier woo the woman he loves.

programme.title: The Trial
programme.desc: Josef K wakes up in the morning and finds the police in his room. They tell him that he is on trial but nobody tells him what he is accused of. In order to find out about the reason for this accusation and to protest his innocence, he tries to look behind the façade of the judicial system. But since this remains fruitless, there seems to be no chance for him to escape from this nightmare.

programme.title: Life with Father
programme.desc: A financier from New York rules his numerous family, consisting of his wife and his four sons, with the meticulousness of a bookkeeper.

programme.title: Behave Yourself
programme.desc: When a cute Welsh terrier follows Bill Denny home, little does he know that all gangland has its eye on that dog.

programme.title: McLintock!
programme.desc: Ageing, wealthy, rancher and self-made man, George Washington McLintock is forced to deal with numerous personal and professional problems. Seemingly everyone wants a piece of his enormous farmstead, including high-ranking government men and nearby Native Americans. As McLintock tries to juggle his various adversaries, his wife—who left him two years previously—suddenly returns. But she isn't interested in George; she wants custody of their daughter.

programme.title: The Proud Rebel
programme.desc: A Confederate veteran living in the Yankee North struggles with his son's shock induced muteness and the hate of the Northerners.

programme.title: Sixty Glorious Years
programme.desc: Picking up where Victoria the Great (1937) left off, this sequel to the 1937 film has Anna Neagle return to the role of Queen Victoria in another colorful account of the revered British monarch's reign.

programme.title: Hit and Run
programme.desc: When an only child is struck by a car and dies, the child's mother seeks vengeance against the driver in this thrilling drama. The car was driven by the wife of a company president who is having an affair. The woman's husband manages to buy silence about the incident, but the victim's mother discovers the identity of the driver. After she secures a job in the home of the company president and his philandering spouse, the woman plans to murder the couple's son when he reaches the age of her late son.

programme.title: A Farewell to Arms
programme.desc: A ravishing adaptation of Ernest Hemingway's legendary novel, A FAREWELL TO ARMS stars Gary Cooper as Lt. Frederic Henry, a young ambulance driver for the Italian army in WWI, more interested in chasing women than the enemy. When seeking cover during an air raid, he encounters Nurse Catherine Barkley, and the world shifts under his feet. They fall in love, but the war keeps wrenching them apart. These painful separations force Frederic to choose between love and battle, a decision that tests him morally and spiritually, and leads to one of the most rapturously romantic endings of all time.

programme.title: True Smile
programme.desc: True smile is the story about a trip through the empty glance of an autist and blind boy who crosses 1.300 kms in tandem bycicle with his brother. This documentary inmerses us into the Sergio's unreachable world, that seems to the desert, the destination of their trip.

programme.title: Night Light
programme.desc: A 14-year-old boy is about to go and live with his mother in the city. Before leaving his hometown, he has to confront his father's inability to give him an integrated family.

programme.title: Trapped
programme.desc: Secret Service agents make a deal with a counterfeiting inmate to be released on early parole if he will help them recover some bogus moneymaking plates, but he plans to double cross them.

programme.title: Carnival of Souls
programme.desc: Mary Henry ends up the sole survivor of a fatal car accident through mysterious circumstances. Trying to put the incident behind her, she moves to Utah and takes a job as a church organist. But her fresh start is interrupted by visions of a fiendish man. programme.title: Legendary Bandits of Mexico
programme.desc: Bandidos Legendarios is a documentary based in four mythical Mexican bandits, trying to find out why they became legendary. They are Joaquin Murrieta, Chucho el Roto, Los Plateados y Heraclio Bernal. Going through the key places where historical facts happened along with historians and specialists, each episode narrates the life of these bandits, trying to find the answers to the great questions that build the myth.

programme.title: Eye To Eye With Everest: Death on A Mountain
programme.desc: Two young cameramen are asked to film a Mount Everest expedition by German mountaineer Thomas Weber; a man wishing to climb Everest, in spite of his visual handicap. For cameramen Milan Collin and Kevin Augello this is a dream come true. They accept the challenge with full excitement In the first weeks Milan and Kevin are confronted with their own physical limitations. Are they capable of climbing this mountain? Surrounded by people who are prepared to die for their dream, giving up is not an option. They are confronted with accidents and death. In the isolated environment Milan and Kevin turn the camera on each other. This film is a personal story of two men confronted with the harsh and extreme conditions high up on the mountain.

programme.title: The Clintons and the Obamas: The Secret Story of a Rivalry
programme.desc: Watch these four charismatic figures and bigger than life characters evolve over a decade at the forefront of the US political scene. These two utterly Mediatic couples united in marriage and politics for better or worse, offer a fascinating reflection of our times. Their story is one of a gigantic game of chess combining love, betrayal, power and money.

programme.title: Cameroon, on the Way To School
programme.desc: More than 66 million school-aged girls do not attend primary nor secondary school worldwide. In the Briqueterie, a disadvantaged district of Cameroon's capital city Yaoundé, 52% of them do not attend school. These girls are Haoussa, a community from Northern Cameroon, the same community the terrorist group Boko Haram comes from. Its name means 'Western education is a sin'. Especially for girls... What are their chances of creating themselves a better future? A literate one? A chance to have a choice?

programme.title: Aramburus Assassination
programme.desc: July, 1st 1970, though Pindapoy operation, Montoneros guerrilla group assassinated Lieutenant General Pedro Aramburu, who in 1955 lead the power grab against General Perón. Constructed as a police drama, Aramburu's Assassination recreates previous scenes to the execution and studies Argentinean left wing guerillas 40 years after their appearance.

programme.title: Volcanic Planet
programme.desc: Volcanoes are the most extreme, dramatic, and explosive forces of nature on our planet. Volcanoes have produced many of the most valuable minerals _ and most of the arable soil on earth. Every day, they are exploding around the world. When the Yellowstone Super Volcano blows (and it is now 48,000 years overdue to do so), it will destroy most of life on North America. Award-winning filmmaker Peter Rowe has climbed and filmed 19 volcanoes, and tells the story of them, the adventures of climbing them, the people who live beside them, and the scientists who risk their lives to study them, in "Volcanic Planet". He also convinces his climbing partner George Kourounis to get married (!?) on the exploding lip of one of them. Filmed in Congo, Iceland, Italy, Vanuatu, Hawaii, Tonga, Turkey, Guatemala, New Zealand, Costa Rica and under the Pacific Ocean, "Volcanic Planet" is a fast-paced high-voltage tour of the world's most active smoking mountains.

programme.title: Assassination II
programme.desc: Assassination II, portrays the murder of Venustiano Carranza, Francisco Villa and Alvaro Obregon, occurred during the last years of the Mexican Revolution. Assassination II is a format that blends the past with the present; historical reconstruction, structured by the questions Who, how and why it will unveil each of the questions surrounding the details of each of the deaths of these important figures in Mexican history. Assassination II , portrays from its unknown side, the personality of the victims, the murderers, and also the personality of the intellectual murderers of each case. The program develops the leadership of historian Pedro Salmerón, in each case, and with a specialist historian that retrace the different lines of research that were taken just after the events, and secret plots hatched to that truth comes to light, while we'll find out the true events revealed after several years of research. With this format, viewers will witness the truths hitherto undisclosed Mexican history.

programme.title: Mongolia, Steppes Emirate
programme.desc: Battered by strong winds, and seen as a grazing land, Mongolia is the kingdom of steppes. With important mineral resources such as copper or uranium, coal and rare soil, Mongolia future is secure: the economy shows a significant growth rate and it is a business paradise for some expatriates. But for most of the population, needs remain unfulfilled.

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: Get your kicks on Route 66 in Flagstaff, AZ. Duck and cover! We're headed to the famous Barringer meteor crater outside of town. Then we scan the stars for heavenly bodies at Lowell Observatory. We'll learn the history of the region at the Northern Arizona History Museum, and finally swing from their many ponderosa pines at Flagstaff Extreme adventure park.

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: We're headed upstate to Albany and Saratoga Springs. We'll take the Albany capital tour and see five former NY governors who would become US Presidents. Then, we'll board the USS Slater and see how America defended its fleet against German U-boats in WWII. We'll sample the mineral water in Saratoga Springs, and bet the farm at their famous thoroughbred raceway. Then, we'll learn how important the Battle of Saratoga was for America's future at Saratoga battlefield.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: How are Rainbows formed and what's their science? We look at the largest Hail ever recorded and explain why it comes in so many shapes and sizes. Global Warming is a big issue and topic, and we give a nutshell insight to its meaning and impact on many levels. Forecasting is key and crucial to living with nature and its weather, as it involves precision technologies and expertise. Typhoon Halyan is an example of one of the most devastating storms in recent history and its story illustrates the power and destruction that Typhoons can cause.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: Snow is a fascinating world of crystals that animals, plants, and humans have had to adapt to, in order to benefit from its best and survive its worst attributes. Some communities live with Tornadoes by building homes with survival features and rather than get out of their paths, they rely on warning systems and classifications. And behind all great weather events is Wind, find out how and why it can change from a gentle breeze into a devastating gale force and where does it go? Nature's force can be mystical and puzzling and the Sunshower has been the subject of myths and legends and superstitions, but it does have a scientific explanation.

programme.title: Big Coast
programme.desc: In the spirit of coastal conservation, Big Coast practices catch-and-release Tyee Chinook Salmon (over 30lbs) angling and only taking what you need. Going strong for 15 years, Big Coast features 13 new half hour episodes every year! A 300-mile boat trip from Vancouver to Duncanby Lodge in Rivers Inlet for Percy Walkus Hatchery Chinook Fundraiser!

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: Ray starts by hitching a lift on a research crane to get a bird's eye view over the Rainforest; from there, he can see the geographical position responsible for this lush vegetation: mountain range in the west and the sea in the east. He then goes down to the ground, delving into the heart of the jungle, he comes across millennial trees, camouflage spiders and a miniature dinosaur, the Boyd's Forest Dragon. He pursues his journey by travelling on a zipwire with wildlife expert, Justin McMahon. Together they observe life in the canopy. Meanwhile, Ray's cameraman Martin Hayward Smith has been filming an animal that can only be found in this part of the world: the Bennett's tree kangaroo, a cute marsupial that lives like a monkey.

programme.title: Sarah Shark
programme.desc: Sarah travels to one of the top 10 dive destinations in Australia (Julian Rocks, Byron Bay, NSW) to dive with three species of Wobbegong Sharks within the Cape Byron Marine Park. She also conducts a street poll with members of the public to find out what they think about sharks.

programme.title: Outta Town Adventures
programme.desc: Outta Town Adventures travels both near and far to discover the best advenures the destinations have to offer. Season 1 visits attractions from California to Rwanda, Switzerland, Iceland, Utah, Zambia, Mexico, The Grand Canyon, Georgia (the Eastern European one) Louisiana, Hawaii, Mauritius and Seychelles. This TV series is dedicated to presenting history, culture and geography in a fun and pisitive way. It encourages people to explore this beautiful world _ something that starts with simply getting out of town!

programme.title: Music Voyager
programme.desc: Music Voyager is a music and travel broadcast series (television/cable, broadband, in-flight and mobile) that invites viewers to discover the exciting sounds of the planet. The host is Jacob Edgar, an explorer who does not search for lost cities or ancient ruins. He's on the quest for a different kind of treasure…music. As an ethnomusicologist and world music record producer, Edgar travels the globe hunting for the best songs the world has to offer, and he suffers through some of the worst…so you don't have to. Along the way, he's rewarded with a backstage pass to concert halls, street festivals, recording studios and rehearsal rooms. With local musicians as his guide, Edgar tastes exotic and occasionally ghastly food, visits off-the-beaten path attractions and parties the night away to amazing concerts at hidden venues that only the locals know. Join music voyager for unexpected adventures and surprising discoveries that unveil the magic, mystery and music of far off lands.

Journeys final stop is to visit the highly endangered Red Colobus monkeys. Learn why these human-like primates eat dirt for survival.

programme.desc: Despite the constant looming threat of globalization, some beloved old traditions, like the Szechuan chili and hotpots are still mainstays in Chinese culture. But while some traditions thrive, some face big challenges. A rare look at the enigma of Tibet shows a culture approaching a crossroads. Even the iconic pandas are dwindling if not for the aggressive breeding programs. Will old traditions stand a chance against the steam-rolling speeds and force of the new world?

programme.title: Hidden Traces

programme.title: Stolen Treasures
programme.desc: It's the biggest museum in the world…the museum of artworks stolen over the centuries and never rediscovered. These works haunt the nightmares of their owners, and occupy the days of hundreds of police officers across the world, as well as those of a handful of private agencies; no country or museum of importance can claim to have been spared. According to Interpol, art theft is the fourth largest criminal trade, after the drug trade, the weapons trade and money laundering. How could it be otherwise, when the soaring price of art propels the value of some paintings into the tens of millions of Euros? This world appears to be full of mysteries. Crime syndicates rub shoulders with petty criminals and the police care more about recovering the items than they do about arresting the perpetrators.

programme.title: Travel Thru History

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: What is La Nina and how is it being monitored? Find out the effects and the reach that this system is influencing. The story of and lessons from Hurricane Katrina give us a great understanding of the ferocity and speed that nature can unleash

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: Weather is universal and it's also Extra Terrestrial. Learn about space weather and how it can impact us on earth. Supercells are unique storms that scientists have learnt to measure into three types. Under the earth's crust, nature is extremely energetic, and we see this through the Volcano which acts as our eye into the forces beneath our feet. Learn about the purple buzzing glow called St Elmo's Fire, how it was named and were to look for it.

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: Ray takes the Great Ocean Road along the Antarctic facing coast of Australia _ the longest South facing coastline in the world. He starts in Port Philp Bay the entrance to Melbourne Harbour where for the first time he sees a strange marine creature _ the weedy sea dragon _ a relative of the sea horse. He also swims with a unique species of dolphin _ the Burrunan Dolphins.Crossing the Bay he heads off down the longest War Memorial in the world _ the Great Ocean Road and meets 93 year old Doug Stirling who remembers the world war 1 veterans building the road.Ray visits the Penguin Colony on Middle Island where guard dogs protect the penguins from foxes and he watches the night time return of the penguins after a day spent at sea fishing.He takes to the seas and discovers the creatures of the deep waters _ albatross, balls of krill and a pod of fast moving common dolphins.

programme.title: Sarah Shark

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: Bangalore is a city with many names: the Garden City, the Pub City, the Fashion Capital the list goes on. Follow Bill as he journeys through this city of contrasts and touches on its many faces. We visit Cubbon Park and Lal Bagh Gardens, shop in the markets and explore the nightlife of the modern city. We also explore architecture, from ancient Bull Temple, the legendary source of the Vishva Bharti River to the largest legislative building in India. Bill's final stop is the "Queen of the Hill Stations" Ooty, where he tours the plantations, rides the historic narrow-gauge railroad and visits the Stone House, which was built by the British in the days of colonial rule.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: These two national parks have some of the most diverse wildlife found on the Indian subcontinent. From the ancestors of our domesticated livestock to leopards, bear and elephants—this is a photographer's paradise. Join Bill as he attempts to track down two of the hardest predators to photograph—the leopard and the sloth bear.

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: All the essentials for going on, and having a successful safari are covered before our host gets a very special challenge—to find at least half of the "Big Twelve" on one safari drive. Four hours and six (6) very special animals—can he do it using his own rules for a successful safari?

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: We elect to stay on a few extra days to try and obtain some good leopard footage. These are the most elusive of the "Big Twelve" and filming them is a major challenge. In the process of tracking leopards, we run across a newborn gazelle trying to walk for the first time. Will it succeed before the predators find it? Can we find and film a leopard up close?

programme.title: Nomads

programme.title: Blue Realm
programme.desc: Believe it or not, many scuba divers want to see great whites up close, and photographers want dramatic shots. But how do you get the sharks to where you want them? For decades, it's been done by baiting, or "chumming" _ attracting sharks with food. This practice is being questioned and banned in many countries because of a dramatic increase in shark attacks.

programme.title: Blue World
programme.desc: Deep in the heart of Mexico's Yucatan, Jonathan is exploring remote cenotes in the jungle that were once used for Mayan rituals. Just reaching the surface of the water requires rappelling down from the forest above. But then, beneath the surface, he encounters strange alien life forms that live in total darkness, and the remains of humans and animal sacrifices from an ancient culture.

programme.title: Blue World
programme.desc: In the Flower Garden Banks National Marine Sanctuary, Jonathan investigates some of the densest coral reefs in the Caribbean as they spawn under cover of darkness. Then he heads over to Silver Springs for the Sea Hunt Forever Festival, celebrating the classic TV show Sea Hunt and the vintage scuba gear that was used on the program.

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: Rafa, the 'Birdman of Loro Parque', proudly leads the Foundation's ornithological work, surrounded daily by parrots, puffins, and penguins. Meanwhile, Inaki faces a challenge: training Sue-Anne the anteater. Armed with vanilla yoghurt and patience, he's hoping charm wins over stubbornness. Will she cooperate or snub his efforts?

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: Ubongo the gorilla has a foot injury, and treating a 400-pound patient takes serious skill. Meanwhile, Ester's team unveils a coral farm—less cuddly, but just as vital. And in the summer heat, Hugo the sloth cools off with a slow-motion shower. From veterinary challenges to marine innovation and quirky animal moments, Loro Parque never stops surprising.

programme.title: Wild Ones
programme.desc: The colossal elephant. The lush tropical forests of Asia hold within them some of nature's mightiest creatures.Each of these silent footsteps carries with it the immense weight of the world's largest land mammal. The intimidating birds with soaring grace and aerial prowess, birds dominate our skies. To remain the undisputed pioneers of the air most bird species are feather light and relatively small. The barrel-like Hippo Lumbering across land, the enormity of the barrel like hippo is without question. Other grass eaters are frail by comparison. The towering giraffe standing taller than any other living animal in their towering majesty is the proud and elegant giraffe. The gigantic whale the Mighty whale graces our oceans with a size and strength unrivalled on land. Three times longer than the tallest giraffe and weighing more than a dozen hippos' the beautiful humpback whale is most famed for its mystical and haunting song. Which is the biggest of them all?

programme.title: Wild Ones
programme.desc: Some animals will never be inconspicuous, others blend so perfectly with their surroundings that they can move through them without detection. Camouflaged cats _ for many of the cats of Africa, camouflage is key to survival. From the spots of the cheetah, the rosettes of the leopard and the stripes and dots of the serval, these cats have evolved to merge with their habitat. Hidden Lizards _ Regal horned lizards vanish into Arizona's deserts, feeding mostly on ants. Cryptic Snakes _ Australia's death adder and carpet python hide in plain sight. Cuttlefish _ Change color, shape, and texture to disappear instantly. Chameleons _ Over 100 species, masters of rainforest disguise. Ptarmigans _ Snow-white birds of the frozen north. Crab Spiders _ Tiny hunters, perfectly matched to bark, leaves, or flowers.

programme.title: Race of Life
programme.desc: Most sea creatures are predators, from tiny fish to giant squid. Built to hunt and survive, they've evolved into efficient underwater war machines. Stonefish lie in wait, disguised, while sharks, barracuda, and moray eels hunt with speed and precision. Reef fish must dodge lightning-fast barracuda and graceful but deadly moray eels. Lionfish use venomous spines, and stonefish can swallow prey whole. In the ocean's depths, survival is a constant battle—an underwater jungle of razor teeth and stealthy ambushes.

programme.title: Race of Life
programme.desc: The ocean is a harsh world where survival depends on feeding and avoiding predators. Sea creatures use camouflage, bright colors, venom, and group behavior for protection. Some hide, others rely on safety in numbers. Even venomous animals must stay alert. From top predators to bottom feeders, each species has evolved unique strategies. Defense includes toxins, teeth, mimicry, and camouflage. Nudibranchs, clownfish, squid, octopus, and orcas are just a few winners in the underwater Race of Life, adapting brilliantly to their environment.

programme.title: Africa's Deadliest
programme.desc: Masters of stealth or speed, using enhanced senses and lethal strategies to hunt, Africa's killers include the incredibly fast cheetah and lions, which while slower, have raw power and ingenious teamwork on their side. The rivers, meanwhile, hold fearsome crocodiles.

programme.title: Creative Killers
programme.desc: Across Africa, predators use the land to amplify their hunting skills. In Ndutu, cheetahs rely on speed and lookout points, even using fawns as bait. Lions, heavier and slower, depend on cover—gullies, marshes, forests—for ambushes. As the wildebeest migration arrives, we follow three characters through the rainy season, watching calves grow and predators adapt. The film explores how these hunters use the landscape, passing knowledge from one generation to the next.

programme.title: Speed Kills
programme.desc: There's more than just one creature lurking in this black lagoon. Here, in this bizarre netherworld between river and ocean, evolution has created a variety of freakish assassins, many of whom can strike in the blink of an eye. Witness the fast-paced, deadly action up close and in slow motion as our high-speed cameras capture sharp-shooting archerfish, African fish eagles, mantis shrimp, and other killers at work. Cutting-edge CGI details show just how they use their alien jaws, spear-like arms, and color-changing skin as weapons of underwater war.

programme.title: Blue Realm
programme.desc: Since the 1970's, sea lion populations have declined more than 80% along the North Pacific coast. Scientists at the University of British Columbia and the Vancouver Aquarium are working together to help save Canada's iconic and largest pinniped _ the stellar sea lion To help understand why their numbers are dropping, researchers work with the highly intelligent mammals at a unique floating laboratory. At The Open Water Research Station, free swimming seals and sea lions are observed in their natural habitat.

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: Posse the red panda and Santiago the saki have been having issues with their teeth. The dentist has arrived but he's got some good news and bad news. The good news is neither of them have to foot the bill. The bad news is, he's brought his big pliers! Ever heard the tale of how the blue throated macaw parrot was saved from extinction and started a new fashion trend in the process? Loro Parque reports from the Bolivian front line and the front row of the local fashion parade!

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: In this episode, Ray explores the Red Centre of the country and shows that the Australian desert is filled with life for those who know where to find water.He arrives in the Red Centre by chopper as he flies over the Uluru monolith or Ayres Rock. For his first stop, he goes to a red kangaroo sanctuary where he cuddles a joey, meets their carer Brolga and gets close to the usually wary adult red kangaroos. He pursues his journey deeper in the desert to meet a local aboriginal Sammy Wilson. They go to a traditional waterhole and chat over a camp fire about Sammy's ancestral knowledge of the land. Ray spends the night out under the stars before driving more inland to rocky areas where water collects. There Ray comes face to face with a wild kangaroo and rock wallabies. He then follows tracks along a dry river bed that lead him to Australia's wild dog: a dingo.

programme.title: Sarah Shark
programme.desc: Sarah travels to one of the top 10 dive destinations in Australia (Julian Rocks, Byron Bay, NSW) to dive with three species of Wobbegong Sharks within the Cape Byron Marine Park. She also conducts a street poll with members of the public to find out what they think about sharks.

programme.title: Music Voyager
programme.desc: Music Voyager is a music and travel broadcast series (television/cable, broadband, in-flight and mobile) that invites viewers to discover the exciting sounds of the planet. The host is Jacob Edgar, an explorer who does not search for lost cities or ancient ruins. He's on the quest for a different kind of treasure…music. As an ethnomusicologist and world music record producer, Edgar travels the globe hunting for the best songs the world has to offer, and he suffers through some of the worst…so you don't have to. Along the way, he's rewarded with a backstage pass to concert halls, street festivals, recording studios and rehearsal rooms. With local musicians as his guide, Edgar tastes exotic and occasionally ghastly food, visits off-the-beaten path attractions and parties the night away to amazing concerts at hidden venues that only the locals know. Join music voyager for unexpected adventures and surprising discoveries that unveil the magic, mystery and music of far off lands.

programme.title: Show Me Where You Live
programme.desc: Show me where you live is a documentary series that aims to answer the following question: How can human beings claim ownership to a space so that they can live safely within it, function as a society, and above all be in harmony with the environment around them? As we discover cultures and emblematic populations, we follow Philippe Simay who is at the heart of Inhabiting the World and represents its identity and originality. Philippe takes us on an epic adventure around the Human Habitat and sets the tone for the journey. As a humanist and philosopher, Philippe is a tireless surveyor of the city, and an explorer of living spaces. Determined to travel around the world, Philippe unveils how the populations that he encounters claim the space they occupy, shapes it and adjust to it.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: Join us as we explore the Gateway to India—Mumbai. From its early history, it's many foreign occupations to the hustle and bustle of today. Bill tells Mumbai's rich history is told through two of its most famous inhabitants, Gandhi and Kipling. We delve into the community of the Parsi faith and learn about their beliefs regarding the circle of life before heading to a little bit of heaven on earth, the coastal paradise of Goa. This hot spot for "in the know" travelers feature white, sandy beaches and is surrounded by tropical plant life. Bill introduces both the armchair and actual traveler to this incredible destination. We explore the Portuguese influence on Goa's architecture and cuisine, tour the ghost city of Old Goa and explore Roman Catholic churches.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: Where can you find literally hundreds of Jain Temples, a lost civilization and one of the top birding destinations in the world—the Bhavnagar region of course. Follow Bill as he attempts to climb 4000 steps to the great Jain temples of Palitana, floats through a lagoon full of flamingoes, egrets and cranes and learns about a kingdom lost to history.

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: Nicknamed the Garden of Eden, this volcanic caldera is home to over 25,000 big game animals. Here survival isn't just a game—it's a matter of life and death. You'll witness one of the great acts of nature—buffalo, lion and hyena in a face-to-face struggle for dominance. Life in the crater can take surprising twists.

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: One of the most modern cities in Africa, Cape Town has something for everyone. We explore the city's architecture, taste a little wine at nearby Vineyards and track down the only penguin species in Africa before reaching the fabled Cape of Good Hope…just a scenic drive outside the city proper.

programme.title: Dream Journey
programme.desc: February 2017 saw me embark upon a travel expedition through Scotland, Poland, France, Mexico, Belize and, (alas!), back. Not only was it the first time I ventured out to Central America, but also the first time I seriously pushed my bravery boundaries to do a whole lot of things I'd never tried before. I defeated my life-long fear of scubadiving and skydiving, (the Carribbean vistas do help! _ No danger I'd do that again in Aberdeen), I went zip-lining over a Mexican jungle, I tried habanero-packed streetfood, (failed at that miserably), and organic tequila, (managed that better;), I climbed a Maya pyramid in the middle of a Belizean rainforest and fed hibiscus flowers to a very extravagant donkey. Most importantly, however, I got to know some incredible people _ from shamans, wanderers and artists to refugees, businesswomen and expat cowboys. And thanks to aaaall of that, I also got to know a little bit more about myself for visiting the most remote corners of our planet reminds you how different and yet how similar we all are. I'm looking forward to sharing my incredible experience in 5 exciting episodes of our travel series, which really turned out to be a Dream Journey:) I sim

programme.title: Mavarski put začina: Šejn Delija

programme.title: Mavarski put začina: Šejn Delija

programme.title: Džejmi Oliver: Džejmi kod kuće

programme.title: Blizanci kosturi
programme.desc: Blizanci Megi i Majlo istog dana izbegnu smrt, što ih ponovo zbližava i tera da se suoče sa razlozima svojih promašaja. I dok se ponovo povezuju, shvataju da je ključ za promenu njihovih života u obnovi odnosa.

programme.title: Nema predaje
programme.desc: Britanska vojska zatvara svog vojnika (Adkinsa) zbog nedoličnog ponašanja, ali ga kasnije oslobađaju i koriste kao tajno oružje u borbi protiv egipatskih vojnika, koje predvodi general Jusef al-Masri u Karmuzu, Aleksandrija, tokom engleske okupacije Egipta.

programme.title: Noćna tabla

programme.title: Strašna strana istorije: Pokvareni Rimljani
programme.desc: Mladi Rimljanin Ati primoran je da se pridruži rimskoj vojsci kada jedna od njegovih "lukavih smicalica" zasmeta lično Neronu. Šalju ga u "bednu, hladnu i vlažnu Britaniju", čiji se stanovnici bune. Stvari postaju još gore kad Atija zarobi Orla, opasna mlada Keltkinja koja gori od želje da se dokaže kao ratnica. Nakon što je za dlaku izbegao vrlo gadan kraj u močvari, Ati koristi znanje stečeno u Rimu kako bi pomogao Orli da spase svoju baku, koju je kidnapovalo suparničko pleme. U međuvremenu, besni Neron odlučuje da uguši pobunu koju predvodi Budika, kraljica Icenija. Ati se ponovo pridružuje rimskim trupama i otkriva da se spremaju za istorijski obračun sa Keltima u bici kod Votling strita. Ati bi mogao sve da zaustavi, ali i da dovede do katastrofe za Orlu, jer se dvoje novopečenih prijatelja sada nalaze na suprotnim stranama bojnog polja.

programme.title: Tajna zmajevog pečata
programme.desc: Engleski putnik Džonatan Grin dobija od Petra Velikog nalog da mapira ruski Daleki istok. Još jednom kreće na dugo putovanje ispunjeno neverovatnim avanturama koje će ga konačno odvesti do Kine. Kartograf će neočekivano naići na mnoštvo izvanrednih otkrića, susresti bizarna stvorenja, upoznati se s kineskim princezama i suočiti sa opasnim majstorima borilačkih veština, pa čak i sa kraljem svih zmajeva.

programme.title: Pirati sa Velikog Slanog Jezera
programme.desc: Kirk Redgrejv je sanjar koji živi s majkom, sve dok njegovo tajno piratsko životarenje ne bude otkriveno i primora ga na selidbu. Sa sobom vodi simpatičnog Flinta i zajedno kreću na Veliko slano jezero, praveći haos među slučajnim turistima i amaterskim mornarima. Kada naiđu na pravu mapu ukletog blaga, počinje luda potraga u kojoj ih prate čudni likovi takođe u lovu na bogatstvo. Ovo je zabavna i neobična priča o prijateljstvu i najluđim fantazijama dvojice ekscentrika.

programme.title: Pas Timber - Lovac na blago
programme.desc: Dečak i njegov najbolji prijatelj (preslatki pas koji govori), daju sve od sebe da sačuvaju svoj dom i porodicu.

programme.title: Deca bez granica
programme.desc: Ešton, Selest i Beka su troje neobičnih srednjoškolskih otpadnika koji formiraju klub u napuštenom pozorištu. Tamo upoznaju Čarlija (Bil Kobs), beskućnika koji deli njihovu ljubav prema muzičkom pozorištu. Kad saznaju za plan da se pozorište sruši, tinejdžeri pokušavaju da ga spasu modernom izvedbom Šekspirovog komada "Mnogo buke ni oko čega". Tokom pripreme predstave, deca uče da se prema drugima odnose s poštovanjem i da se bore za svoja uverenja. U filmu igra i Li Meriveder, nominovana za Zlatni globus.

programme.title: Peščani čovek
programme.desc: Jednog jutra, Beno pronalazi pesak u svom krevetu. Iako u početku pokušava ovo da ignoriše, ubrzo shvata da taj pesak ispada iz njega. Iz dana u dan, količina peska je sve veća i njegovo vreme ubrzano ističe. Na kraju nema izbora i pomoć traži od Sandre, vlasnice omanjeg kafea ispod njegovog stana. Iako je Beno strastveno mrzi, počinje da je sanja svake noći. Kakva je veza između Sandre, snova i peska?

programme.title: Mister Olimpija
programme.desc: Inspirativna priča o začetnicima fitnesa kakvog danas poznajemo, Džou i Benu Vajderu. Suočeni s antisemitizmom i velikim siromaštvom, braća su savladala sve prepreke, izgradila imperiju i inspirisala buduće generacije.

programme.title: Vidimo se u septembru
programme.desc: "Vidimo se u septembru" je originalna romantična komedija, smeštena u moderni Menhetn. Film govori o Lizi, prelepoj ženi koja naizgled ima sve, ali se duboko u sebi plaši vezivanja. Kad sazna da će njen terapeut celog avgusta biti na odmoru, šokirana je i uplašena. Umesto da ovu vest prihvati smireno, ona traži pomoć od ogorčene prijateljice, Monike.

programme.title: Mali diktator
programme.desc: Lenji diplomirani pravnik usvaja dete kako bi zadivio devojku, ali ništa ne ide po planu. Sada mora da odraste i nauči kako da se nosi sa izazovima očinstva.

programme.title: Arbitraža
programme.desc: Finansijski oslabljen tajkun, koji je novac stekao zahvaljujući hedž fondovima, očajnički pokušava da proda svoju trgovinsku imperiju, ali pravi grešku koja ga primorava da se za pomoć obrati na neočekivanom mestu.

programme.title: Na pogrešnom putu
programme.desc: Četvorica mladića upuštaju se u rizičnu investiciju, koja ih vodi u sukob s mafijom.

programme.title: Deveri
programme.desc: Mladoženja i njegova četvorica kumova suočavaju se s pitanjima sopstvenog prijateljstva i zrelosti nedelju dana pred venčanje.

programme.title: Osećaj kraja
programme.desc: Muškarca progoni prošlost, a tajanstveno nasleđe primorava ga da preispita sopstveni život i odluke.

programme.title: Osećaj kraja
programme.desc: Muškarca progoni prošlost, a tajanstveno nasleđe primorava ga da preispita sopstveni život i odluke.

programme.desc: Poznata advokatica lepljivom trakom vezuje svog muža preljubnika za klozetsku šolju, malo pre nego što u kuću upadnu provalnici.

programme.title: Noćas nećeš spavati
programme.desc: Dečaka progone zastrašujuće noćne more u kojima se čudovište krije u ormaru. Na njegovo olakšanje, otac se pojavljuje usred noći kako bi mu pomogao da se suoči sa svojim strahovima. Ali dečak će početi da preispituje pravu prirodu ovih prikaza, prisiljen da se suoči sa istinom o sudbini svog oca i zloj sili koja preti da ga obuzme.

programme.title: Gvido superstar: Gvidov uspon
programme.desc: U ovoj urnebesnoj akcionoj komediji italijanski doseljenik upada u svet narko-bosova, super automobila i tajnih agenata. Nakon što je izgubio posao u kompaniji Disko Valet zbog neumesnog junaštva, Gvido mora za FBI da izigrava sicilijanskog gangstera kako bi se infiltrirao u moćnu azijsku bandu. Stvari kreću naopako i postaju sve gore. Gvido to mora da ispravi pre nego što ga otkriju i ubiju ili, još gore, deportuju.

programme.title: Polje izgubljenih cipela
programme.desc: Zasnovano na istinitoj priči iz Američkog građanskog rata. Kadetski tinejdžeri sa Vojnog instituta u Virdžiniji, zaštićeni od ratnih užasa, iznenada su pozvani da brane dolinu Šenandoa u bici kod Nju Marketa 1864. godine. Primorani da prerano ostave svoju mladost iza sebe, ovi kadeti moraju odlučiti za šta se tačno bore.

programme.title: Ujak Nino
programme.desc: Otuđena i prilično disfunkcionalna porodica ponovo se zbližava, kada im iz Italije u Čikago u iznenadnu posetu dođe očev davno izgubljeni ujak Nino.

programme.title: Hajdi
programme.desc: Omiljena priča o Hajdi stiže na velike ekrane! S više od pedeset miliona prodatih knjiga širom sveta, prevedena na preko pedeset jezika, Hajdi je već svetska zvezda. Nežna priča o detinjstvu i prijateljstvu za čitavu porodicu.

programme.title: Dnevnik Bridžet Džouns
programme.desc: Na startu Nove godine, 32-godišnja Bridžet odlučuje da preuzme kontrolu nad svojim životom i počinje da vodi dnevnik. Ubrzo se nađe rastrzana između šarmantnog Danijela i ozbiljnog Marka, dok posao i prijatelji dodatno komplikuju njen haotični svet.

programme.title: Bridžet Džouns na ivici razuma
programme.desc: Četiri nedelje od početka njene nove veze, Bridžet počinje da sumnja u Marka. Osim što otkriva da glasa za konzervativce, suočava se s novim šefom, čudnim saradnikom i najgorim odmorom u životu.

programme.title: Beba Bridžet Džouns
programme.desc: Nakon raskida s Markom Darsijem, Bridžet, ponovo sama i u svojim četrdesetim, posvećuje se poslu i prijateljima, uverena da sve drži pod kontrolom. A onda upoznaje šarmantnog Amerikanca Džeka i ostaje trudna. Problem je u tome što nije sigurna ko bi mogao biti otac.

programme.title: Bridžet Džouns: Luda za njim
programme.desc: Bridžet kao udovica i samohrana majka uz pomoć porodice, prijatelja i bivšeg ljubavnika Danijela pokušava da pronađe balans. Vraća se poslu i dejting aplikacijama, gde je privlači mlađi muškarac, koji je sasvim slučajno i učitelj njenog sina.

programme.title: Dnevnik opijanja
programme.desc: Krajem pedesetih godina prošlog veka, neuspeli pisac postaje radnik propalog časopisa u Portoriku, gde upada u kandže alkohola, postaje deo sumnjive šeme za eksploataciju zemljišta i zaljubljuje se u prelepu, ali verenu ženu.

programme.title: U raljama zveri
programme.desc: Potraga bivšeg agenta CIA za otetom ćerkom uvlači ga u mrežu političkih spletki, korupcije, opasnosti i izdaje.

programme.title: Slom
programme.desc: Policajka se sa ćerkom vraća u rodni grad da brine o teško bolesnoj majci. Međutim, ubistvo mlade sugrađanke otvara istragu koju zapravo niko ne želi da vodi, pa ona ostaje duže nego što je planirala kako bi otkrila istinu.

programme.title: Iskupljenje
programme.desc: Ostareli bivši bokser i gangster, koji radi kao batinaš za bostonskog mafijaša, dobija tešku dijagnozu. Dok mu pamćenje polako vene, on pokušava da ispravi grehe prošlosti i obnovi vezu s decom, odlučan da ostavi nešto dobro svom unuku. Ipak, podzemlje nikoga ne pušta tako lako iz svojih kandži.

programme.title: Pobuna vanzemaljaca
programme.desc: Petoro mladih jednog jutra shvata da su ostali bez mobilnih telefona, struje i radija. Dok pokušavaju da prežive u toj neobičnoj situaciji, ugledaju ogroman leteći tanjir. Ubrzo, poznata civilizacija počinje da puca, i petoro prijatelja nađe se usred potpune anarhije.
